label: Diagram 2.9
caption: Diagram 2.9 Division of corridors
description: Diagram 2.9, "Division of corridors", shows four views in a grid, with "See para 2.27" top left. The top row are two plans. Method 1 is a plan of a "Corridor" shaded green, containing two "Fd" doorsets with swing arcs; a green block above the corridor, pointed to by the label "Cavity above ceiling", and a strip below labelled "Floor cavity". A legend shows a green block for "Cavity barrier", a green line for "Fire resisting construction", and "Fd" for "Fire doorset". Method 2 is a similar plan where the corridor is flanked by green blocks labelled "Fire resisting sub-division", with a continuous green strip across the top pointed to by "Cavity above ceiling" and a strip below labelled "Floor cavity". The bottom row are vertical sections, Section A and Section B, each showing the corridor with "Fd" doors, staircase grids, and green lines plus dashed and dash-dot lines. A central legend keys these to "Fire resisting construction", "Cavity barrier to ceiling cavity", and "Cavity barrier to ceiling cavity above fire resisting sub-division". Pointers read "Cavity barriers on line of corridor enclosure to any cavity above" and "Fire resisting sub-division. Any cavity above to have cavity barriers". A paragraph headed "NOTES:" appears at the bottom left, with an unheaded paragraph at the bottom right.
